name: 53589 · Stoughton, WI
findings: ZIP 53589 (Stoughton) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53589 (Stoughton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53589 (Stoughton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
